text: WOUNDED, JIM MAKES AN ATTEMPT TO CRAWL BACK TO CAMP -

SUDDENLY, HE UTTERS A CRY OF
ABJECT TERROR, AS HE FINDS HIS PATH
OBSTRUCTED BY TWO BULL LIONS!

AT THIS MOMENT, A PIERCING, UN-
EARTHLY CRY ECHOES AND RE-ECHOES
FOR MILES AROUND AS A HUMAN FORM
HURTLES DOWN FROM THE DIZZY HEIGHTS
OF THE TOPMOST BRANCHES OF THE TALL
EST TREES, WHIRLING FROM BRANCH TO
BRANCH, FORTY AND FIFTY FEET APART!

AS THE FIRST
BEAST IS ABOUT
TO LEAP FOR THE
KILL--!
